title: Strategy v2 against v1: A1's adoption, A2's verdict and safeguard 2
spec: research/strategy/v2-spec.md (A1, A2, A4-A6, the Clarification before the v2 build and the Clarification to A2's measurement)

readings.cscv_blocks: the returns between consecutive marks of nav.csv, cut into 10 contiguous blocks by numpy.array_split
readings.cscv_rule: rule 1 on the new positions whose decision date's close falls in the half (V-weighted mean of a1.json's ratio); rules 2 and 3 on the half's returns joined in time order: compounded return (same number of returns for both variants, so any annualisation keeps the order) and maximum drawdown with the starting value as a peak
readings.cscv_worse: the pick does worse on the test half when the A1 rule applied to the test half picks the other variant; per-criterion outcomes reported beside it
readings.windows_3y: a window starts at every mark and ends at the last mark dated on or before the same calendar date three years later; calendar-day CAGR (365.25), maximum drawdown from the window's first value

a1_adoption.definition: research/strategy/v2-spec.md A1 and the Clarification before the v2 build ('A1's adoption test, made exact'): (b) is adopted only if all three hold, otherwise (a)

rules.name: entry_price
rules.text: the average price paid for new positions, relative to the adjusted close on the session before each position's decision date, is lower in (b)

rules.name: cagr
rules.text: annual return (full-period CAGR) is not lower in (b)

rules.name: max_drawdown
rules.text: maximum drawdown (full period) is not worse in (b)

a1_adoption.check: rules 2 and 3 equal each run's metrics.json (cagr, max_drawdown) and rule 1 its metrics.json a1.v_weighted_ratio, to 1e-9

a2_verdict.definition: research/strategy/v2-spec.md A2 as the Clarification to A2's measurement (2026-09-26) fixes it: v2 replaces v1 only if all five hold

rules.text: maximum drawdown over the full period at least 5 percentage points smaller than v1's
Sortino and Calmar, as quantstats computes them, both higher than v1's
IIMA four-factor annual alpha (statsmodels, Newey-West HAC 3 lags, no small-sample correction) not lower than v1's over the same months, and its t-statistic not lower than v1's
annual one-way turnover, including the initial build, not higher than v1's
capacity not worse: the 95th percentile, over every buy and sell, of trade value over the stock's 60-session median turnover, at Rs 5 lakh, not higher than v1's

a2_verdict.verdict: v1 stays: v2 does not replace it

hand_rolled_t_beside.note: the n/(n-k) corrected t, reported beside the A2 figure, not used for it

capacity_decision_date_fills_beside.note: percent; only fills on a decision date, which misses v2's later tranches

beside.note: each criterion alone on the test half, for the pick against the other variant; not the probability of overfitting, which uses the whole rule

cscv_a1_choice.logit_note: with two variants the pick's relative rank on the test half is 2/3 or 1/3, a logit of +ln 2 or -ln 2, so the probability of backtest overfitting is simply the share of splits in which it is -ln 2
cscv_a1_choice.check: the same rule on all ten blocks picks the adopted variant, as the run files' figures do
cscv_a1_choice.definition: combinatorially symmetric cross-validation (Bailey, Borwein, Lopez de Prado and Zhu 2017) of A1's choice, as the Clarification before the v2 build defines it

bootstrap.method: jobs/libcheck_v1.margin_interval, the bootstrap v1's final test used: 90% interval for the difference in compound annual growth of two NAV series, each draw rebuilding both paths from the same resampled returns

v2_minus_v1.method: stationary bootstrap of paired daily returns, mean block 21 sessions, 5000 draws, statistic = difference in compound annual growth

v2_minus_its_universe_ew.method: stationary bootstrap of paired daily returns, mean block 21 sessions, 5000 draws, statistic = difference in compound annual growth

v1_minus_its_universe_ew.method: stationary bootstrap of paired daily returns, mean block 21 sessions, 5000 draws, statistic = difference in compound annual growth

bootstrap.note: percentage points of compound annual growth; stationary bootstrap of paired returns between marks, mean block 21, 5000 draws, seed 7 (jobs/libcheck_v1.margin_interval, as v1's final test used)

windows_3y.note: windows overlap almost entirely from one to the next, so they are far from independent: this is a description of the path, not a sample

factor_indices.definition: excess CAGR = strategy CAGR minus the index's total-return CAGR (calendar days) on the run's clock (jobs/attribution.py); the live part starts at the close of the index's first live date (Clarification to A4). 'tie' where the reading with no overnight move at endpoints NSE printed no open for gives the other answer

live_part.basis: first date NSE printed an open (fallback)
first date NSE printed an open (fallback)
NSE printed an open at the clock start (fallback): live over the whole period
NSE printed an open at the clock start (fallback): live over the whole period
NSE printed an open at the clock start (fallback): live over the whole period

quality_factor.definition: IIMA four-factor regression without and with the A5 quality factor, on identical months checked in code (jobs/attribution.py); margin and ROCE versions are the headline, '_no_r6' (loss-makers kept) robustness only

roce.label: headline: ROCE, its months from March 2023

after_tax.definition: jobs/after_tax.py (v2-spec A6): itemised Indian costs and slippage, capital gains tax by lot with advance tax; statistics from the value if everything were sold at each mark after exit costs and tax; benchmark: a growth-option Nifty 500 index fund held throughout

monkey_test.engine: v2: zen.portfolio.engine_v2.Replay (the run's config, decision dates, ranks, trend-filter cash, panel and A1 table)
